Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Phase 1: Switch from popup to in-page modal \(Shadow DOM\)

BREAKING CHANGE: UI is now an in-page modal, not a browser popup

- Removed popup/ directory entirely
- manifest.json: removed default_popup, using action.onClicked
- background/index.ts: sends TOGGLE_MODAL on icon click
- content/index.ts: creates modal in closed Shadow DOM
- content/modal.html: modal HTML structure \(layout shell\)
- content/modal.css: modal styles \(injected inline via ?raw import\)
- vite.config.ts: builds only content + background, no popup
- vite-env.d.ts: TypeScript declarations for ?raw imports

Modal behavior:
- Click extension icon → modal appears \(bottom-right, fixed position\)
- Click again → modal hides
- Click X button → modal hides
- Shadow DOM isolates styles from page CSS

Verification:
- grep -r "chrome." dev_build/core/ returns nothing ✓
- npm run build succeeds ✓
- TypeScript compiles without errors ✓
